## What's Changed

- Adds 34 distinct Tater-themed wordmark logos for automatically generated
  genre, decade, movie, and television channels.
- Serves the same server-owned logo to Tater Tube Player guide cards and the
  optional on-screen channel overlay, keeping each channel's identity
  consistent.
- Adds separate server controls for enabling the automatic-channel overlay and
  choosing its corner. The default is enabled in the bottom-right corner.
- Keeps custom channel logos and their existing overlay setting independent, so
  user-created channels continue to work as before.
- Exposes proper poster, backdrop, series, season, and episode artwork on the
  versioned Player Home API for richer modern-player cards.
- Rebuilds an expired guide immediately after a host clock correction instead
  of waiting for the next planner interval.
- Bumps the guide cache format so existing installations automatically receive
  the new channel logo metadata.

## Compatibility

The new artwork metadata and automatic-channel logo behavior are additive.
Existing Tater Tube players, custom channels, and their playback routes remain
compatible.

## Upgrade

Use your container manager's **Update/Recreate** action to pull
`ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest` and recreate the existing
container with its current settings.

No configuration or database migration is required. Update and relaunch Tater
Tube Player to see the generated logos in the modern guide.
